**Meta cancelled the second wave of its AI-driven restructuring.** Reuters reporting, relayed by IBTimes UK, says Mark Zuckerberg dropped the November phase of "Project OT" the night before the May layoffs, which still cut about 10% of staff. Internal data showed code changes up 220% year on year while features reaching users rose only 36%, and major incidents up 40%. Meta declined to comment on the figures. [IBTimes UK, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/meta-ai-restructuring-zuckerberg-cancels-layoffs-1816629)
